notes: Color Studio: saved palettes, color harmonies, batch recoloring and undo. Chat Emoticons: 22 built-in 64x64 plushie PNG icons plus 12 SVG reactions; SVG codes shortened to :happy:, :love:, etc. (filenames unchanged). Loona plushie selection and lore placeholder fixed, along with Rey, Margot, Mara and Eva selection mapping. Universal Search removed.

items: Color Studio with saved color palettes, matching color harmonies, batch recoloring and undo.
Chat Emoticons picker with 22 embedded 64x64 plushie PNG icons and the 12 original SVG reaction emoticons.
Filename-based chat codes for plushie PNG icons, using :hari: for hari'.png.
Original SVG emoticon chat codes no longer require the subby prefix (for example, :happy:, :love:, :blush: and :hug:). SVG asset filenames remain unchanged.
Older :subby...: SVG chat codes remain supported for backward compatibility.
Loona plushie selection now maps to the correct item and loona.png.
Loona lore displays "Loona's lore is to come soon."
Corrected plushie selection mappings for Rey, Margot, Mara and Eva.
Universal Search and its keyboard shortcuts.
